title.zh: 万事达卡开放AI代理支付，提供早期访问和现场演示
title.en: Mastercard Opens Up AI Agent Payments With Early Access and Live Demo

current_state.zh: Mastercard 已开放 Agent Pay for Machines 早期接入，AI 代理可通过 x402 支付凭证在人类设定预算内发现并支付服务，由 Coinbase 钱包、Base 链上结算及 BVNK 法币/稳定币通道支持；并已进行 live demo、提供开发者 API/SDK/沙盒，且与 Cloudflare、AWS、Coinbase 等开展试点。
current_state.en: Mastercard has opened early access to Agent Pay for Machines, letting AI agents discover and pay for services within human-set budgets via x402 payment vouchers settled through Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails; it has also run a live demo, offered developer APIs/SDKs/sandbox, and begun pilots with Cloudflare, AWS and Coinbase.

updates.title_zh: 万事达卡开放AI代理自主支付系统早期接入
updates.title_en: 万事达卡开放AI代理自主支付系统早期接入
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增事实：Mastercard 在 Cloudflare Connect 大会上演示了 Agent Pay for Machines 的实际交易，一个营销代理在单一预算下向两家独立商户完成 9 笔支付；同时宣布向开发者提供买卖方 API、SDK 和沙盒，并已与 Cloudflare、AWS、Coinbase 等开展端到端试点。
updates.what_changed_en: New facts: Mastercard demonstrated live Agent Pay for Machines transactions at Cloudflare Connect, with a marketing agent completing 9 payments to two independent merchants under one budget; it also announced buyer/seller APIs, SDKs and a sandbox for developers, and end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, AWS and Coinbase.
updates.current_state_zh: Mastercard 已开放 Agent Pay for Machines 早期接入，AI 代理可通过 x402 支付凭证在人类设定预算内发现并支付服务，由 Coinbase 钱包、Base 链上结算及 BVNK 法币/稳定币通道支持；并已进行 live demo、提供开发者 API/SDK/沙盒，且与 Cloudflare、AWS、Coinbase 等开展试点。
updates.current_state_en: Mastercard has opened early access to Agent Pay for Machines, letting AI agents discover and pay for services within human-set budgets via x402 payment vouchers settled through Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails; it has also run a live demo, offered developer APIs/SDKs/sandbox, and begun pilots with Cloudflare, AWS and Coinbase.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Mastercard opened early access to its Agent Pay for Machines system, letting AI agents autonomously discover services, negotiate and pay under human-set budgets via the x402 protocol with Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails, alongside developer APIs, SDKs and a sandbox.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mastercard opened early access to its Agent Pay for Machines system, letting AI agents autonomously discover services, negotiate and pay under human-set budgets via the x402 protocol with Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails, alongside developer APIs, SDKs and a sandbox.
